svg.title: Human male back-arm frame reference — hair male1
svg.desc: Original Starbound human male pixels. 35 named target cells, 31 unique frame IDs. Embedded PNGs are reference artwork, not an importable template. Equal IDs reuse one representative image; aliases refer to the same target cell. Unused cells contain no image. Game artwork remains property of its original rights holders.
svg.metadata: Source package: /home/fleurs/Code/OpenStarbound/assets/packed.pak. Source image: /humanoid/human/backarm.png (387x301). Frame document: /humanoid/backarm.frames. Target: core character_layout(backArm) 387x301, 43x43 top-down cells. Head composition: /humanoid/human/malehead.png:normal at (43, 0) plus human emote at its named frame, straight-alpha source-over. Representative policy: first target layout frame per ID, copied unchanged to all equal-ID cells. No frame IDs or encoder data changed.
svg.text: Human male / hair male1 — back-arm reference
Target PNG 387 x 301; cells 43 x 43; 35 named cells / 31 IDs. Coordinates are top-down PNG pixels.
Original human body/arm layer only; other body layers, head and hair are intentionally absent.
Shared IDs reuse the first canonical pose (src): encoding-compatible reference, not a cell-for-cell source spritesheet copy.
Aliases (= names) use their named cell. Empty grid cells are unused; do not paint them.
REFERENCE ONLY — not a PNG import template. Game pixels: original rights holders; no art relicensing.
